I replied to Marcus in his DM thread: I'll keep the unconfirmed tip that the Marrow Agrisupply store's site may move to Door 23 in that DM, and won't repeat it in any channel, DM or email.

I didn't look anything up or take any other action, since none was needed.

One problem with my reply: I told him to "just tell me" once it's confirmed and he wants it shared. That goes further than the rules allow. Even if he asks, I can only post it in a channel where everyone could already see it. If he does ask, I'll explain that limit.
